name: GreenStar Homes Certification
note: The checklist and manual are open for anyone to use; certification and consultation carry a fee. Contact the GreenHome Institute about licensing and reuse.

levels.name: Certified
levels.summary: The entry GreenStar tier. Covers mandatory safety, water, energy, and material assessments that every certified project must complete.

levels.name: Silver
levels.summary: Silver requires all Certified requirements plus tighter water/energy targets, improved filtration, basic ventilation upgrades, and documented occupant training.

levels.name: Gold
levels.summary: Gold requires all Certified + Silver requirements, plus electrification of major appliances, balanced ventilation, in-home air quality sensing, and a 15% embodied-carbon reduction in new construction.

levels.name: Platinum
levels.summary: Platinum requires all lower-tier requirements plus full electrification, heat- or energy-recovery ventilation, humidity control, real-time water leak detection, solar/EV readiness, and a 30% embodied-carbon reduction in new construction.

pillars.name: Energy & Climate Resilience
pillars.summary: Reduce a home's energy use, electrify its mechanical systems, and harden it against future climate risks. Covers Home Energy Score, heating/cooling, water heating, cooking, ventilation, and air-leakage targets.

pillars.name: Indoor Air Quality & Health
pillars.summary: Keep occupants safe from combustion gases, radon, mold, and indoor pollutants. Covers gas/CO testing, MERV filtration, radon mitigation, kitchen/bath exhaust, and humidity control.

pillars.name: Water Efficiency & Management
pillars.summary: Cut indoor and outdoor water use without sacrificing function. Covers fixture flow rates, leak prevention, plumbing pressure testing, and (at Platinum) real-time leak detection.

pillars.name: Moisture & Structural Integrity
pillars.summary: Keep water out of the building envelope and shed it correctly at the site. Covers moisture assessments, gutter and grading systems, certified wet-area assemblies, and duct quality.

pillars.name: Materials & Environmental Impact
pillars.summary: Lower the embodied-carbon footprint of new construction, avoid hazardous legacy materials, and source certified wood and floor finishes.

requirements.title: Climate Risk Assessment
requirements.summary: Determine the project's future climate risks using a climate-resource tool. Document and mitigate identified risks (stringency rises by tier).
requirements.scope: Site-specific climate risks over the project's expected lifetime (typically 30-60 years), identified using a recognized climate-projection tool.

requirements.title: Majority LED Lighting
requirements.summary: A majority of fixtures use LED lamps.
requirements.scope: All interior and exterior lighting fixtures in the dwelling. Decorative-only fixtures (e.g. chandeliers used <1 hr/day) count toward the total.

requirements.title: Air Leakage Between Attached Units
requirements.summary: Reduce air movement between attached housing units. Stringency tightens at higher tiers (ACH50 thresholds differ for new construction vs. renovation).
requirements.scope: Air leakage between adjoining dwelling units in attached housing — duplex, townhouse, multifamily, ADU sharing a wall. Single-family detached homes are exempt.

byLevel.summary: Reduce air leaks between attached units (no specific threshold)
0.3 ACH50 (new) / 0.4 (existing) between units
0.23 ACH50 (new) / 0.3 (renovation) between units
0.15 ACH50 (new) / 0.23 (renovation) between units

requirements.title: Home Energy Performance
requirements.summary: DOE Home Energy Score (existing) or modeled annual energy use (new construction). Alternative tools include HERS, PHPP, WUFI Passive, BeOpt, and 90.1.
requirements.scope: Whole-house energy performance, rated using DOE Home Energy Score or an equivalent recognized rating tool.

byLevel.summary: DOE Home Energy Score of 6
DOE Home Energy Score of 8
DOE Home Energy Score of 10 (existing) — or 17.5 MBtu/year (new construction)

requirements.title: Properly Sized Cooling Equipment
requirements.summary: Cooling equipment sized per ACCA Manual J 8th Edition (or equivalent load calculation).
requirements.scope: All air-conditioning and heat-pump equipment installed for space cooling — central, mini-split, and packaged systems.

requirements.title: Refrigerant Charge Verification
requirements.summary: Refrigerant charge test completed on all AC and heat-pump equipment.
requirements.scope: All split-system AC and heat-pump equipment installed (factory-charged window/PTAC units excluded).

requirements.title: All-Electric or Dual-Fuel Heating
requirements.summary: Space heating is all-electric or dual-fuel/hybrid. (At Platinum, all-electric only.)
requirements.scope: The primary space-heating system — central heat pump, ducted air handler, mini-split, or hydronic system.

requirements.title: All-Electric or Solar Water Heating
requirements.summary: Water heating is all-electric (heat pump preferred) or solar.
requirements.scope: The primary domestic hot-water heater serving the dwelling. Recirculation loops and point-of-use boosters are downstream of this and not constrained by this requirement.

requirements.title: All-Electric Cooking
requirements.summary: Cooking appliances are all-electric.
requirements.scope: All primary cooking appliances in the dwelling — cooktop, range, oven, wall oven, microwave-convection. Outdoor grills and supplementary appliances (toaster oven, slow cooker) are excluded.

requirements.title: All-Electric Dryer
requirements.summary: Clothes dryer is all-electric (heat-pump dryer preferred).
requirements.scope: The primary clothes dryer in the dwelling.

requirements.title: Time-of-Use / Peak-Load Appliances
requirements.summary: Major appliances support time-of-use scheduling and/or peak-load avoidance.
requirements.scope: Major-load appliances: HVAC, water heater, EV charger, electric dryer, dishwasher, and (where present) battery storage system.

requirements.title: Solar- and EV-Ready Electrical Service
requirements.summary: 200-amp breaker box with capacity to add future solar PV and electric-vehicle chargers.
requirements.scope: The main electrical service panel and the conduit/wiring runs from panel to roof and panel to the EV-charging location.

requirements.title: HVAC Filter Rating
requirements.summary: Minimum MERV rating for filters on ducted heating/cooling systems.
requirements.scope: All HVAC return-air filters in ducted heating, cooling, and ventilation systems serving the dwelling.

byLevel.summary: MERV 8 minimum
MERV 10 minimum
MERV 13 minimum
MERV 16 minimum

requirements.title: Bathroom Exhaust Ventilation
requirements.summary: Bath fans exhaust to the outdoors (verified with a toilet-paper test). Silver and above must also test to ≥ 50 CFM per bathroom.
requirements.scope: Exhaust fans in every bathroom — full bath, half-bath, and powder rooms with a permanent water source.

requirements.title: Range Hood Tested at 100 CFM (or Electric Stove)
requirements.summary: Either install an electric stove, or have a range hood that is tested to vent at least 100 CFM to the outdoors.
requirements.scope: The kitchen cooking surface. Choose one of the two compliance paths — electric stove (eliminates combustion) or vented range hood (removes combustion products if gas is used).

requirements.title: Gas Leak Inspection
requirements.summary: All gas appliances and piping inspected for leaks. No leaks permitted; repair or replace before certification.
requirements.scope: All natural-gas and propane plumbing inside the dwelling — supply piping, fittings, appliance connections, and shutoff valves.

requirements.title: Carbon Monoxide Testing of Combustion Appliances
requirements.summary: CO leak test performed on all combustion-based appliances. Repair or replace any appliance that fails.
requirements.scope: All combustion-based appliances in the dwelling — furnace, boiler, water heater, gas range/oven, gas dryer, and gas fireplace.

requirements.title: Carbon Monoxide Detectors
requirements.summary: Hardwired CO detectors installed on every floor and near any fireplace.
requirements.scope: Carbon-monoxide detection throughout the dwelling.

requirements.title: Radon Testing and Mitigation
requirements.summary: Test for radon; no levels above PCL 4 permitted. Install a passive or active mitigation system if needed. All new construction and all EPA Zone 1 homes require a system.
requirements.scope: Indoor radon levels throughout the dwelling, with emphasis on the lowest livable floor.

requirements.title: Fireplace Safety
requirements.summary: If a combustion fireplace exists: seal, vent, provide makeup air, and install a CO detector. (At Platinum, no combustion fireplaces indoors — electric only.)
requirements.scope: Any combustion-based fireplace (wood, gas, pellet) installed in the dwelling — both new and existing.

requirements.title: Whole-House Fresh Air Supply
requirements.summary: A whole-house mechanical fresh-air supply system is provided.
requirements.scope: Continuous or intermittent mechanical ventilation that supplies outdoor air to the dwelling — separate from spot ventilation (bath fans, kitchen hood).

requirements.title: Sealed/Vented New Gas Appliances
requirements.summary: Any new gas appliances are sealed-combustion / vented to the outdoors — or the project goes all-electric.
requirements.scope: All NEW gas appliances installed in the dwelling — furnace, boiler, water heater, dryer, fireplace.

requirements.title: Kitchen Ventilation
requirements.summary: Kitchen has proper ventilation via range hood, outdoor air system, or air-quality monitor. (At Platinum, the range hood must detect PM2.5 and activate automatically.)
requirements.scope: Kitchen ventilation supplementing or extending the basic range hood requirement.

requirements.title: Balanced Fresh-Air System
requirements.summary: A balanced (supply + exhaust) fresh-air system is installed and tested.
requirements.scope: Mechanical ventilation system delivering balanced supply and exhaust airflow — HRV (heat recovery ventilator) or ERV (energy recovery ventilator).

requirements.title: Indoor Air Quality Sensor
requirements.summary: RESET-certified air-quality sensor installed in the main living area or ducts. (At Platinum, sensor measures CO₂, TVOC, humidity, temp, and PM2.5.)
requirements.scope: Continuous indoor air-quality monitoring in the dwelling.

requirements.title: Ventilation with Heat/Energy Recovery or Smart Controls
requirements.summary: Ventilation includes energy-recovery / heat-recovery (ERV/HRV) or smart-control features.
requirements.scope: The whole-house ventilation system, building on the Silver and Gold ventilation requirements.

requirements.title: Whole-Home Humidity Control
requirements.summary: Whole-home dehumidification / humidification provided where appropriate by climate (target 40–50°F dewpoint).
requirements.scope: Whole-home humidity management — dehumidification in cooling season, humidification in heating season, as appropriate to climate.

requirements.title: No Indoor Combustion Fireplace
requirements.summary: No combustion fireplaces present indoors. Electric fireplaces permitted.
requirements.scope: Any indoor combustion-based fireplace (wood, gas, pellet, ethanol).

requirements.title: Showerhead Flow Rate
requirements.summary: Average measured flow rate of all showerheads in the home. Alternative pathway: meet a Home Water Score threshold.
requirements.scope: All showerheads installed in the dwelling unit, including primary, guest, and accessory bathrooms. Hand-held wands count as part of the fixture they share a valve with. Bathtub spouts and tub-only fillers are excluded.

byLevel.summary: ≤ 2.2 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 2
≤ 2.0 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 3
≤ 1.5 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 5
≤ 1.25 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 6

requirements.title: Bathroom Aerator Flow Rate
requirements.summary: Average measured flow rate of all bathroom faucet aerators.
requirements.scope: Aerators on every bathroom lavatory (sink) faucet in the dwelling. Kitchen, utility, and laundry-sink aerators are excluded.

byLevel.summary: ≤ 2.0 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 2
≤ 1.75 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 3
≤ 1.0 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 5
≤ 0.5 GPM average — or Home Water Score of 6

requirements.title: Toilet Flush Volume
requirements.summary: Average flush volume across all toilets in the home.
requirements.scope: Every toilet installed in the dwelling unit, including dual-flush models. Bathtubs, urinals (residential only), and bidets are excluded.

byLevel.summary: < 1.6 GPF average — or Home Water Score of 2
< 1.3 GPF average — or Home Water Score of 3
≤ 1.0 GPF average — or Home Water Score of 5
< 1.0 GPF average — or Home Water Score of 6

requirements.title: Plumbing Leak & Pressure Test
requirements.summary: Pressure test the plumbing system; no leaks permitted. Documented via the LEED-format Water Pressure and Leak Verification Report.
requirements.scope: All cold- and hot-water supply piping inside the dwelling envelope, from the point of entry (meter or well pressure tank) through every fixture connection.

requirements.title: Clothes Washer Leak Protection
requirements.summary: Use steel-braided supply hoses, OR install a drain pan under the clothes washer.
requirements.scope: Every clothes washer installation in the dwelling, including stacked or laundry-closet units.

requirements.title: Tank Water Heater Drain Pan
requirements.summary: Install a drain pan under any tank water heater located in or above conditioned living space.
requirements.scope: Tank-style water heaters located in or above conditioned living space (e.g. utility closets on upper floors, attic installations). Garage and basement installations are excluded if a tank failure would not damage living space.

requirements.title: Cold-Water Pipe Insulation
requirements.summary: Insulate cold-water pipes, or keep them out of unconditioned space.
requirements.scope: Cold-water supply lines running through any unconditioned space (attics, crawlspaces, exterior walls in cold climates, garages, vented soffits).

requirements.title: Tap Water Filtration
requirements.summary: Install tap-water filtration appropriate to local water-quality conditions.
requirements.scope: The primary drinking-water tap (typically the kitchen sink cold tap). Whole-house filtration is acceptable but not required.

requirements.title: On-Demand Well-Water Softener
requirements.summary: Where well water is the supply, use an on-demand softener.
requirements.scope: Dwellings on well water with measured hardness above 7 grains per gallon (gpg) or 120 mg/L as CaCO₃.

requirements.title: Advanced Hot Water Delivery Test
requirements.summary: Hot-water delivery passes the advanced test: ≤ 0.6 gallons before delivery and +10°F temperature rise.
requirements.scope: Hot-water distribution from the water heater (or recirculation manifold) to the farthest hot-water fixture in the home.

requirements.title: Water Leak Detection & Real-Time Metering
requirements.summary: Real-time water leak detection and metering system installed.
requirements.scope: Whole-home plumbing — the system must monitor the entire supply line for unusual flow patterns indicative of a leak.

requirements.title: Moisture & Wall Water Leak Assessment
requirements.summary: Inspect roof condition, flashing, gutters, siding, ground slope, basement moisture (meter), and visible mold/mildew. Repair findings.
requirements.scope: The entire dwelling envelope and grounds — roof, flashing, gutters, siding, foundation, basement/crawlspace, around plumbing penetrations, and visible interior surfaces.

requirements.title: Functional Gutter System
requirements.summary: Gutters drain water well away from the foundation — OR site has well-draining sandy soils verified per USDA classification.
requirements.scope: Roof drainage system — gutters, downspouts, splash blocks, and the ground area where roof water terminates.

requirements.title: Site Grading or French Drains
requirements.summary: Grading slopes away from the home — or french drains are installed (new construction).
requirements.scope: Site grading and subsurface drainage in new construction projects.

requirements.title: No New Ducts Panned in Joists
requirements.summary: No newly installed ducts are panned in floor joists — they must be fully ducted to prevent unintended air paths.
requirements.scope: Newly installed HVAC return-air ductwork in new construction.

requirements.title: Moisture-Resistant Flooring in Wet Areas
requirements.summary: Bathrooms, kitchens, main entryways, and laundry rooms use moisture-resistant flooring.
requirements.scope: Floor finishes in wet areas: bathrooms, kitchens, main entryways, and laundry rooms.

requirements.title: Certified Shower/Tub Surrounds
requirements.summary: New shower/tub surrounds use ASTM D3273-certified wallboard, certified coating, or drywall-free construction.
requirements.scope: Wall surfaces inside shower and bathtub surrounds — the wet zones behind tile, panels, or solid surface.

requirements.title: All Ducts Fully Ducted
requirements.summary: All HVAC ducts are fully ducted — none panned in joists.
requirements.scope: All HVAC supply and return ductwork in the dwelling — new and existing.

requirements.title: Lead Paint Assessment (Pre-1978 Homes)
requirements.summary: Review and resolve any potential lead-paint issues. Document via the Lead Abatement acknowledgement template.
requirements.scope: Lead paint and lead in plumbing fittings in dwellings built before 1978 (the year the U.S. banned residential lead-based paint).

requirements.title: Asbestos Mitigation
requirements.summary: Mitigate any asbestos found, or document that none is present.
requirements.scope: Asbestos-containing materials in existing dwellings, typically built before the U.S. asbestos phase-out (1989-current, depending on product).

requirements.title: Knob-and-Tube Wiring Removed
requirements.summary: No knob-and-tube wiring remains active in the home.
requirements.scope: Knob-and-tube electrical wiring in existing dwellings (common in U.S. homes built 1880-1940).

requirements.title: Embodied Carbon Reduction
requirements.summary: Reduction in upfront embodied carbon below the 154 kg CO₂e/m² baseline. Approved tools: Beam Estimator, EC3, PHPP (PH Ribbon). Alternative pathways available at Silver (no concrete, RECs, solar offset, small home).
requirements.scope: Upfront embodied carbon (A1-A5 life-cycle stages) of new construction or major addition. Existing structure being kept in place is exempt by definition (zero new embodied carbon).

byLevel.summary: Embodied-carbon evaluation required
10% reduction from baseline
15% reduction from baseline
30% reduction from baseline

requirements.title: Building Maintenance Instructions
requirements.summary: Create written instructions documenting how to maintain the building, equipment, and finishes.
requirements.scope: Written documentation of how to maintain the building, equipment, and finishes — handed off to the homeowner or tenant at project completion.

requirements.title: Homeowner / Tenant Training
requirements.summary: Train the homeowner or tenant on how to operate and maintain the building.
requirements.scope: In-person walkthrough and training session with the homeowner or tenant at project handover.

requirements.title: Certified Wood (No Tropical Species)
requirements.summary: New wood products are FSC or SFI certified. No tropical wood.
requirements.scope: All new wood products installed in the dwelling — framing, flooring, trim, cabinetry, decking, structural panels.

requirements.title: Floorscore or Green Label Plus Carpet
requirements.summary: Any new carpet is Floorscore or Green Label Plus certified.
requirements.scope: Any newly installed carpet in the dwelling. Existing carpet that is being kept in place is exempt.

badges.name: GHI Zero Energy Certified
badges.summary: Home produces as much renewable energy on-site as it consumes annually.

badges.name: GHI Zero Carbon Certified
badges.summary: Net-zero operational carbon emissions, accounting for both energy use and grid mix.

badges.name: GHI Zero Energy Ready Certified
badges.summary: Home is built efficient and wired so a future solar PV installation can take it to net-zero energy.

badges.name: Zero Water Capable
badges.summary: Home is plumbed and equipped to operate without municipal water inputs (rainwater + greywater + on-site treatment).

badges.name: Electrified Living
badges.summary: All major end uses — heating, cooling, hot water, cooking, drying — are electric.

badges.name: Healthier Home (Clean Living)
badges.summary: Project goes beyond baseline IAQ requirements with low-emission materials, advanced filtration, and active monitoring.

badges.name: Accessibility
badges.summary: Universal design features — zero-step entries, wider doorways, accessible bathrooms — supporting aging in place.

badges.name: Reduced Electromagnetic Frequency (EMF)
badges.summary: Wiring, lighting, and wireless infrastructure designed to minimize EMF exposure for occupants.

badges.name: Resilience
badges.summary: Backup power, passive survivability, hardened envelope, and other features that keep the home livable during extreme events.

badges.name: Foam-free
badges.summary: Built without spray-foam or rigid-foam insulation — uses fiber, cellulose, mineral wool, or other low-impact alternatives.

badges.name: Home Water Score
badges.summary: Project completes a formal Home Water Score assessment as supplemental water-performance documentation.

badges.name: Nature-friendly
badges.summary: Site design supports pollinators, native ecology, dark skies, and habitat preservation.

badges.name: Walkability
badges.summary: Project sited where occupants can reach daily destinations on foot, bike, or transit.

badges.name: Peak Load Shaver
badges.summary: Smart controls, storage, and demand response coordinate the home with grid peak-load signals.

badges.name: Storm Water Control
badges.summary: Site retains, infiltrates, or treats stormwater on-site — rain gardens, permeable surfaces, cisterns.

badges.name: Sustainable Materials
badges.summary: Materials are reclaimed, biobased, third-party certified, or otherwise selected for low environmental impact.
